hypoglycemia.definition: Hypoglycemia means blood glucose is below a healthy range for the person.

glycemia.definition: Glycemia refers to glucose in the blood, also called blood sugar.

cardiorenal_health.definition: Cardiorenal syndrome describes heart or kidney problems that can worsen function in the other organ system.

safety_tolerability.definition: Drug tolerability is the extent to which adverse effects can be tolerated by a patient.

access_cost.definition: Access/cost represents practical affordability and coverage constraints that affect whether therapy can be obtained.
